content: Dr. Cherian Varghese serves as the Responsible Technical Officer at the WHO headquarters, focusing on the management of noncommunicable diseases (NCDs). Dr. Andre Ilbawi also works in the same department, contributing to NCD management. Dr. Nicola Magrini is affiliated with the WHO’s Essential Medicines and Health Products division, specializing in policy, access, and use. Dr. Marie-Charlotte Bouesseau is part of the Service Delivery and Safety team at WHO headquarters. Dr. Nicolas Clark is involved in mental health and substance abuse management at WHO. Dr. Slim Slama works in the Eastern Mediterranean Region, focusing on NCD management. Mr. Lee Sharkey is a consultant in NCD management at WHO headquarters. Dr. Gauhar Afshan, an anesthesiologist specializing in pain management and guideline development, is based at Aga Khan University in Karachi, Pakistan. She has declared no conflicts of interest. Dr. Zipporah Ali, a palliative care specialist and Executive Director of the Kenya Hospices and Palliative Care Association, has expertise in pain policy and guideline development. She has no significant conflicts of interest. Dr. Chioma Asuzu, from the University of Ibadan in Nigeria, specializes in psycho-oncology, nursing, and psychology. She has no declared conflicts of interest. Dr. Eduardo Bruera, a medical oncologist and palliative care expert at the University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center, has participated in end-of-life care projects and has no significant conflicts of interest. Dr. Jim Cleary, affiliated with the University of Wisconsin Carbone Cancer Center, focuses on palliative care, pain management, and pain policy. He has no declared conflicts of interest. Dr. Malcolm Dobbin, a public health expert from Australia, specializes in toxicology and pharmaceutical misuse. He has no significant conflicts of interest. Dr. Kathleen Foley, an emeritus neurologist at Memorial Sloan-Kettering Cancer Center, has extensive experience in palliative care and cancer pain management. She has no significant conflicts of interest. Ms. Harmala Gupta, based in New Delhi, India, focuses on palliative care policy and cancer survivorship. She has no declared conflicts of interest. Dr. Eric Krakauer, from Harvard Medical School, specializes in palliative care and pain policy. He has no significant conflicts of interest. Dr. Philip Larkin, a palliative care nursing expert from University College Dublin, has served as president of the European Association of Palliative Care. He has no declared conflicts of interest. Mr. Diederik Lohman, affiliated with Human Rights Watch, has conducted research and advocacy on palliative care. He has no significant conflicts of interest. Dr. Sebastian Moine, a general practitioner in France, focuses on primary palliative care and has received research funding from the French Ministry of Health. He has no significant conflicts of interest. Dr. Hibah Osman, founder of the Balsam Lebanese Center for Palliative Care, specializes in family medicine and hospice care. She has no declared conflicts of interest. Dr. Lukas Radbruch, director of palliative medicine at the University Hospital Bonn, is a leader in pain management and policy. He has no significant conflicts of interest. Dr. MR Rajagopal, from the Trivandrum Institute of Palliative Sciences in India, is an anesthesiologist and palliative care expert. He has no declared conflicts of interest. Dr. Paul Sebastian, director of the Regional Cancer Centre in Kerala, India, specializes in surgical oncology and has no significant conflicts of interest. Dr. Nandi Siegfried, co-director of the South African Cochrane Centre, has expertise in guideline methodology and has received consultancy funding from WHO. She has no significant conflicts of interest. Dr. Catherine Stannard, a pain management expert in the UK, has chaired clinical and policy groups on opioid prescribing. She has no declared conflicts of interest. Dr. Jane Turner, from the University of Queensland, specializes in psychiatry and psycho-oncology. She has no significant conflicts of interest. Dr. Verna Vanderpuye, a radiation oncologist in Ghana, has no declared conflicts of interest. Ms. Verna Walker-Edwards, a pharmacist from Jamaica, focuses on pain policy and has no significant conflicts of interest. Dr. Geoff Mitchell, from the University of Queensland, has been a site investigator for novel analgesics and has no significant conflicts of interest. Dr. Anil Paleri, from the Institute of Palliative Medicine in India, specializes in anesthesiology and palliative care. He has no declared conflicts of interest. Dr. Tania Pastrana, affiliated with the Latin American Association for Palliative Care, focuses on palliative medicine and has no significant conflicts of interest.
